title.narrative: Support to the production of reliable and policy oriented statistics and investment promotion in Rwanda

description.narrative: The project's purpose is to develop and implement a national tourism statistics system and marketing strategies to enhance Rwandas promotion as a high quality tourism and investment destination.The expected results are:1)Improved capacity to collect and analyse services statistics in Rwanda leading to increased number of policy-relevant services data. 2)A strong national brand and positioning strategy is implemented. 3)Rwanda further promoted on the world stage specially in Europe
